other.label: CBO cost estimate: H.R. 1968, Full-Year Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025

summary: H.R. 1968, the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025, provides funding for federal agencies through the remainder of fiscal year 2025 to prevent a government shutdown. It funds most programs and activities at fiscal year 2024 levels while extending various expiring public health, Medicare, Medicaid, human services, and other federal programs and authorities through September 30, 2025.

affected_groups.effect: Receive full-year fiscal year 2025 funding to maintain operations through September 30, 2025.

Maintains continued access to telehealth services, extended hospital and ambulance payment adjustments, delayed Medicaid disproportionate-share hospital reductions, and low-income program outreach funding.
affected_groups.group: Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries and providers

affected_groups.effect: Receive extended federal funding through fiscal year 2025 for community health centers, the National Health Service Corps, and teaching health center graduate medical education.
affected_groups.group: Community health centers and medical training programs

key_provisions: Provides continuing fiscal year 2025 appropriations for federal agencies through September 30, 2025, generally funding programs and activities at fiscal year 2024 levels.
Extends funding through fiscal year 2025 for community health centers, the National Health Service Corps, and the Teaching Health Center Graduate Medical Education Program.

Extends numerous Medicare provisions and flexibilities through fiscal year 2025, including telehealth expansions, low-hospital payment adjustments, ground ambulance add-on payments, and the acute hospital care at home program.
Delays scheduled reductions to Medicaid disproportionate-share hospital allotments until fiscal year 2026.
Extends public health programs, including special diabetes programs for Type I diabetes and American Indians, and various emergency preparedness and response authorities.
Extends human services and education authorities, such as the Sexual Risk Avoidance Education Program and the Personal Responsibility Education Program.

Extends other federal authorities through fiscal year 2025, including the Commodity Futures Trading Commission whistleblower program, Department of Homeland Security drone mitigation authorities, and the temporary DEA scheduling of fentanyl-related substances.

summary_detail.plain_summary: H.R. 1968, the Full-Year Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2025, provides funding for federal agencies through the remainder of fiscal year 2025 to prevent a government shutdown. It funds most programs and activities at fiscal year 2024 levels while extending various expiring public health, Medicare, Medicaid, human services, and other federal programs and authorities through September 30, 2025.
summary_detail.significance: The legislation prevents a government shutdown by funding federal operations through the end of fiscal year 2025 and ensures the uninterrupted continuation of numerous major health, social service, cybersecurity, and national security programs and authorities.
